onboarding.readBody: Every row and column has a header: a club or a country.
onboarding.answerBody: Pick a cell and type a footballer who fits both of its headers. You have {{seconds}} seconds.
onboarding.winBody: Three cells in a line win the game. If nobody manages it, the side with more cells wins.

welcome.guestHint: Your guest account stays on this phone.

register.title: Create account
register.usernameHint: Your username cannot be changed later.

home.subtitle: Name a footballer who fits both the row and the column.
home.modeFriendHint: Open a private room with a code.
home.subtitleDuel: Pick seven cards. Each round, the better card for the question scores.
home.subtitleDraft: Each round reveals a club. Add a footballer who played there to your lineup; the lineup with more career assists wins.
home.subtitleHigher: Two footballers, one question: whose goals, assists, value or age come out on top? Keep answering right to keep your turn.
home.subtitleChain: Take turns naming someone who played at the same club as the last footballer. Miss or get it wrong and you lose the round; three rounds win.
home.subtitleRare: Both of you name a footballer who fits both criteria; answers stay hidden. If both are right, the less known footballer takes the round.
home.subtitleAuction: Bid how many names you can list. The player who is told "Prove it" takes the round only by naming that many right answers in time.
home.subtitleTopTen: There is a hidden list of ten. Take turns naming players; the lower on the list, the more points. A wrong name costs a life.
home.subtitleCareer: A hidden footballer's clubs open one by one. Guess with fewer clues for more points; a wrong guess opens a new club and passes the turn.
